string.name: Title
string.value: Weapon Defense

string.name: Desc
string.value: The higher your Weapon Defense, the less weapon damage you will receive from enemies. It is determined by adding your Weapon Defense stat to that of all equipped armor items.

string.name: Title
string.value: Magic Defense

string.name: Desc
string.value: The higher your Magic Defense, the less magic damage you will receive from enemies. It is determined by adding your Magic Defense stat to that of all equipped armor items.

string.name: Title
string.value: Weapon Accuracy

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines the accuracy of your Weapon Attack. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at accurately aiming your weapon attacks. It is determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Title
string.value: Magic Accuracy

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines the accuracy of your Magic Attack. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at accurately aiming your magic attacks. It is determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Title
string.value: Weapon Avoidability

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines your chance of avoiding weapon attacks. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at avoiding weapon attacks. It is determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Title
string.value: Magic Avoidability

string.name: Desc
string.value: Stat that determines your chance of avoiding magic attacks. The higher it is, the better chance you will have at avoiding magic attacks. It is determined by adding your stat to the options of items equipped.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Your movement speed cannot be increased beyond 140%. Skills and equipment can be used to increase or decrease your speed. Speed can be increased to 190% while riding a mount.

string.name: Desc
string.value: How high you can jump. It cannot be increased beyond 123%. Skills and equipment can be used to increase or decrease your Jump.

string.name: Title
string.value: Character Name

string.name: Desc
string.value: No changes can be made after creation.

string.name: Title
string.value: Character Job

string.name: Desc
string.value:
You can take a Job Advancement once you reach milestone levels.
1st Job Advancement: Lv. 10
2nd Job Advancement: Lv. 30
3rd Job Advancement: Lv. 60
4th Job Advancement: Lv. 100.

string.name: Title
string.value: Character Level

string.name: Desc
string.value: Gain experience to increase your character's level.

string.name: Desc
string.value: When this reaches 100%, your level will increase. You can obtain EXP by hunting monsters or completing quests.

string.name: Title
string.value: Honor Level

string.name: Desc
string.value: Accumulate Honor EXP to increase your character's Honor Level. You will receive a Circulator with each level-up, up to Lv. 31, when you will gain Circulators for earning set amounts of Honor EXP.

string.name: Title
string.value: Honor EXP

string.name: Desc
string.value: Once you reach 100% Honor EXP, you will gain a new Honor Level. Honor EXP can be acquired from Medals of Honor in the Fight for Azwan.

string.name: Desc
string.value: This is your current Guild. Press the G key to see your Guild’s information.

string.name: Title
string.value: Health Point

string.name: Desc
string.value: You will be incapacitated if your HP reaches 0. Monster attacks, some special skills, and even standing in dangerous areas will decrease your HP. Max HP: 500,000

string.name: DescAvenger
string.value: You will be incapacitated if your HP reaches 0. Monster attacks, some special skills, and even standing in dangerous areas will decrease your HP. This is the most important stat for the Demon Avenger's attacks. Max HP: 500,000

string.name: Title
string.value: Mana Points

string.name: Desc
string.value: Required for many skills. Max: 500,000

string.name: TitleDemon
string.value: Demon Fury

string.name: DescDemon
string.value: Used for all Demon Slayer skills. This stat can only be increased through the use of a Demon Aegis.

string.name: Desc
string.value: Your fame increases or decreases based on other users. Some equipment and quests require a certain level of fame.

string.name: Title
string.value: AP (Ability Point)

string.name: Desc
string.value: Used to increase STR, DEX, INT, LUK, HP, and MP. For STR, DEX, INT, and LUK, every 1 AP used will increase the stat by 1. For HP and MP, the increase will differ based on your character and job. You will receive 5 AP each time you level up.

string.value: Strength determines the attack strength of Xenon's melee weapon.
